_comment: Settings for scripts/audit_data.py. Every value is a stated expectation, not a measured fact.

name_aliases._comment: Audit-only spelling variants, applied after strict normalisation. Not a crosswalk; only exact known variants, no fuzzy matching.

atoll_aliases._comment: Atoll labels across datasets, normalised to Census atoll_code lower-case.

male_area_note: Census MLE-coded islands are Maale, Hulhumaale, Vilingili and K.Hulhule; OneMap codes the three main ones as atoll 'MLE'.
